allies.rationale_text: Feedback-loops give iteration the signal path that makes each cycle produce learning rather than repetition for its own sake.
allies.source_quote: Iteration is the physical manifestation of a healthy feedback loop.
allies.affinity_rationale: Described as 'the physical manifestation of a healthy feedback loop' — iteration IS how feedback loops get realized in practice through continuous improvement cycles.
allies.activation_condition: When feedback signals need to be converted into systematic action cycles rather than remaining as passive data collection

allies.rationale_text: Experimentation turns iteration into disciplined test-and-learn movement instead of undirected activity.
allies.affinity_rationale: Iteration provides 'the systematic process needed to prove, disprove, or modify' active hypotheses — the operational engine that makes experimental method actionable.
allies.activation_condition: When hypothesis testing requires a structured cycle of test, analysis, and re-test rather than one-shot experimentation without refinement

allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking keeps iteration connected to the wider machine so each loop updates the structure, not just a local artifact.
allies.source_quote: Iteration is essential for managing living systems, which are not amenable to simple linear beliefs.
allies.affinity_rationale: Iteration is 'essential for managing living systems' that are not amenable to simple linear beliefs — provides the temporal dimension systems thinking needs for dynamic analysis.
allies.activation_condition: When understanding complex system behavior requires repeated observation and adjustment cycles rather than one-time structural analysis

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias turns iteration into a ritual that protects the current direction instead of genuinely updating the hypothesis.
antagonists.source_quote: Confirmation bias ... works against the iterative process, where ideas must be constantly updated and changed as learning progresses.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Confirmation bias 'works against the iterative process' by filtering information to reach desired conclusions — directly corrupts the evidence-updating that iteration demands.
antagonists.activation_condition: When cycle reviews are used to confirm the current direction rather than genuinely testing whether the initial hypothesis should be revised based on new evidence

antagonists.rationale_text: Status-quo-bias makes iteration ceremonial by preserving the current approach even after new loop evidence points elsewhere.
antagonists.source_quote: iteration conflicts with status-quo-bias (status quo bias) when review loops become ceremonial and prevent substantive change.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Status quo bias causes review loops to become ceremonial and prevents substantive change — iteration degrades into ritual when the default is always to continue the current path.
antagonists.activation_condition: When iteration cycles produce evidence for change but organizational inertia maintains the existing approach through ceremonial rather than genuine review

structured_tensions.tension_text: Iteration conflicts with commitment-bias when teams resist pivoting after new cycle evidence.
structured_tensions.source_quote: iteration vs commitment-bias: iteration conflicts with commitment-bias (commitment and consistency bias) when teams resist pivoting after new cycle evidence.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Iteration conflicts with status-quo-bias when review loops become ceremonial and prevent substantive change.
structured_tensions.source_quote: iteration vs status-quo-bias: iteration conflicts with status-quo-bias (status quo bias) when review loops become ceremonial and prevent substantive change.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Iteration conflicts with confirmation-bias when cycle reviews are used to confirm the current direction rather than genuinely test whether the initial hypothesis should be revised.
